title: 佔兩個位
subject: carrying a second-hand Carousell keyboard home across two seats of a 2 a.m. night bus while a drunk passenger asks for a song
caption: Hong Kong twee indie pop with a lo-fi home-recording feel. A cheap home keyboard playing simple bouncy chords with a slightly wobbly tone, a nylon-string guitar strumming light bossa-tinged chords, a basic drum-machine pattern with a soft brushed snare, a melodica taking the short solo and a glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody. Short, dry and plain, small-room and narrow, the voice and keyboard forward. Sweet, untrained, breathy female lead, almost spoken, quoting the other passengers' lines in a flatter deadpan tone. 100 BPM, F major. Tired, amused and quietly delighted. No big drums, no electric guitar solo, no autotune, no orchestral strings, no stadium reverb.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Carousell三百蚊 一部二手電子琴
賣家喺葵芳 約我凌晨一點半
抬唔上上層 坐喺下層最尾
佢佔咗兩個位 我坐喺佢隔籬

[Pre-Chorus]
每次轉彎 我就扶實佢
好似扶住一個 飲醉咗嘅朋友

[Chorus]
凌晨兩點 通宵巴士
一部琴 佔咗兩個位
有人想瞓覺 有人想返屋企
我淨係想 佢唔好跌落地

[Verse]
真係飲醉咗嗰個阿叔 行過嚟坐低
佢話「靚女 彈首嚟聽吓」
我話「佢入咗六粒電芯 唔知仲有冇電」
一撳落去 佢自己彈起首生日歌

[Chorus]
凌晨兩點 通宵巴士
一部琴 佔咗兩個位
阿叔跟住唱 我跟住彈
司機 收細咗佢部收音機

[Outro]
落車嗰陣 阿叔同我講
「下次 彈首新啲嘅」
